photos.title: Panorama of The Market Common, Myrtle Beach (May 2023) 01
photos.what: A four-story building in The Market Common town center: shops on the brick ground floor, three floors of homes with balconies above, a corner tower with a cupola, street trees and a flower bed at a corner of the street.
photos.caption: Homes over the shops in the town center. These apartments are rented by the year, not sold.
photos.alt: A four-story building with shops on the ground floor and apartments with balconies above, on a street in The Market Common
photos.author: DiscoA340
photos.credit: Photo: DiscoA340, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

photos.title: WarbirdPark
photos.what: Warbird Park on Farrow Parkway: an A-10 attack plane seen from behind, with its two engines and twin tail, the nose of an A-7 at right, three flagpoles, a brick plaza and trees.
photos.caption: Warbird Park on Farrow Parkway: an A-10, the kind of attack plane the base flew, and an A-7 beside it.
photos.alt: An A-10 jet seen from behind and an A-7 jet beside it, on display on a brick plaza with flags at Warbird Park

photos.caption: The lake in Grand Park, beside the town center's shops. It has a 1.1-mile path around it.
